headline: What salary you need to afford a two-room apartment. How much new housing has become more expensive in the last 3 years
summary: Prices for new apartments in Romania rose almost 50% over the last three years. The average useful area of new flats has slightly decreased over the same period.
why: Housing costs and affordability influence consumer spending, mortgage demand and the construction sector.
